original_test_intent: Cycle every approved PCIe endpoint link through each supported generation for 500 loops and verify every requested speed negotiates correctly, retains expected width and recovers without errors.
original_method: Pin vendor module/config; map safe link/endpoint allowlist and supported-generation matrix; preserve logs and baseline speed/width/AER/I/O; approve transition order, loop meaning and per-state oracle; drain dependent I/O; run monitored cycles with first-failure stop; restore preferred speed and services, then verify health.
manual_activity: PCIe owner approves target paths, supported speeds and maintenance window; operator drains I/O and owns recovery.
required_inputs: Supported PCIe generations and expected width per path
I/O drain, restore target and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never change speed on unbounded all-bridge scope
Preserve logs rather than clear them
Stop on first failed negotiation, AER, I/O or management anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Run one bounded allowlisted transition campaign
Collect per-state/per-loop link and error evidence
Restore preferred speeds and report without DUT verdict
